name: PT Kobexindo Tractors Tbk
summary: PT Kobexindo Tractors Tbk, together with its subsidiaries, distributes and services heavy equipment in Indonesia. The company operates through Heavy Equipment, Sparepart, Repair and Maintenance, and Others segments.
